STRIKES & ATTACKS:
  • US/Israeli airstrikes killed a top Hamas naval police commander linked to Oct. 7 (IDF claim).
  • Hezbollah fire in southern Lebanon killed one IDF officer and wounded another during a ground operation.
  • Lebanese culture minister says Israeli strikes damaged heritage sites in south Lebanon.
Northern Border
  • Daily Hezbollah activity continues. Skirmishes and raids persist along the border.
  • IDF pulled back slightly — first practical test of the Lebanon deal.
Diplomacy & Pauses

  • Pakistan is mediating between parties.
Iraq & Regional Actions

Hormuz & Shipping
  • Iran is allowing passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) while blocking others — selective control of the strait.
Other
  • Police seized a stolen shoulder‑mounted anti‑tank launcher in southern Israel.
  • Partial reopening: Eastern Rail Line resumed limited service. Aliyah of skilled olim continues.
🟢 Good News
  • Removal of a senior Hamas naval commander. Seizure of a rocket launcher. Baghdad arrests targeting Iran-backed networks. Partial rail service restored.

Day 27 — Key developments

Active strikes/sirens:
  • Iran launched missile/rocket strikes into Kuwait and Bahrain after US/Israeli strikes on Iran. Kuwait intercepted two ballistic missiles; Bahrain reports damage to a residential building.
  • Airspace disruption: airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan remain closed. Multiple military flights logged over the region.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah active daily. Recent skirmish killed an IDF officer and wounded another during southern Lebanon operations.
  • Israeli strikes reported to have damaged Lebanese heritage sites—Lebanese authorities protest.

Strait of Hormuz & Gulf

  • Iran allows passage for select states (Russia, India, China) and blocks others. CENTCOM says two recent Hormuz targets were newly built Iranian installations.
  • US/Israeli strikes and Iranian counterstrikes continue to use Gulf launch points, raising risk to commercial traffic.

Diplomacy & mediation

  • Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran-focused energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET), claiming Iranian request and “talks going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.
  • US presses Syria to act against Hezbollah—regional tensions rise; Iraq raids Tehran-linked officials in Baghdad Green Zone.

Other tactical notes

  • IDF reports a top Hamas naval-police commander (Oct. 7 attacker) killed in recent strikes.
  • Previous 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr—sets low trust for pauses.

🟢 Good News

  • Kuwait intercepted incoming ballistic missiles. Israeli strike reportedly eliminated a senior Hamas naval commander. Partial Israeli rail line reopened domestically.

Threat assessment:

Escalating and volatile.

  • שיבוש אווירי: נמלי תעופה באיראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון וירדן סגורים. טיסות צבאיות נרשמות באזור.

גבול צפון

  • חיזבאללה פעיל מדי יום. חילופי אש אחרונים הובילו למות קצין צה"ל ולפציעת אחר.

  • איראן מאפשרת מעבר למדינות נבחרות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות. פיקוד המרכז האמריקאי דיווח ששני יעדים שהותקפו הורכבו לאחרונה על ידי איראן.
  • התקיפות ההדדיות מהמפרץ מגדילות סיכון לתנועת סחר.

  • טראמפ הודיע על הפסקת אש שנייה ל-10 ימים בנוגע למתקפות אנרגיה (המועד האחרון 6.4.2026 בשעה 20:00 ET), לטענתו לפי בקשת איראן ו"שיחות מתקדמות"; איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת.

הערות טקטיות

🟢 חדשות טובות

הערכת איום:

התחממות ועלייה בסיכונים.
